label: General
tooltip: Which activities to run, mount, AI, Return, and repair.

prefer_pot_fates.label: Prefer pot FATEs
prefer_pot_fates.tooltip: Boost scoring for pot FATEs when choosing a FATE. Also enables pot timing and preposition (see Pot timing).

should_farm_pot_chests.label: Farm pot chests after pot FATEs
should_farm_pot_chests.tooltip: After a pot FATE, open linked chests. Reroll chests are on Pot timing.

should_preposition_to_pots.label: Preposition to pots before spawn
should_preposition_to_pots.tooltip: Leave early and wait near the predicted pot. Timing comes from Pot timing.

should_do_critical_encounters.label: Do Critical Encounters
should_do_critical_encounters.tooltip: Select and run Critical Encounter goals.

toggle_ai_provider.label: Use BOCCHI AI
toggle_ai_provider.tooltip: Enable the BOCCHI AI BossMod preset for FATE/CE combat (targeting and combat movement). While pathfinding it is turned off and turned back on when you arrive. Off = no BOCCHI AI.

should_auto_mount.label: Auto-mount while traveling
should_auto_mount.tooltip: Mount before long pathfinds and remount if you dismount mid-route (e.g. after Treasure Sight) while heading to a FATE or CE.

stay_mounted_while_waiting_for_ce.label: Stay mounted while waiting for CEs
stay_mounted_while_waiting_for_ce.tooltip: Do not auto-dismount after arriving at a preparing CE. You still dismount when the encounter starts.

stop_after_return.label: Stop after return
stop_after_return.tooltip: Return (and teleport to the inbound aetheryte) toward the next FATE or CE, then pause for manual pathing. Toggle the mode to resume auto-nav.

phantom_jobs_leveling_mode.label: Phantom jobs leveling mode
phantom_jobs_leveling_mode.tooltip: When your current phantom job reaches max level, switch to the next unlocked job that is not maxed. Stays put if every unlocked job is maxed.

should_cast_treasure_sight.label: Cast Treasure Sight
should_cast_treasure_sight.tooltip: Automatically recast Treasure Sight while running.

treasure_sight_recast_interval_seconds.label: Treasure Sight recast interval (seconds)
treasure_sight_recast_interval_seconds.tooltip: How often to recast Treasure Sight.

max_remote_idle_time_seconds.label: Max Return delay after FATE/CE (seconds)
max_remote_idle_time_seconds.tooltip: After a FATE or CE ends, wait a random time between 2 seconds and this value before casting Return.

auto_repair_threshold.label: Auto-repair threshold (%)
auto_repair_threshold.tooltip: Repair equipped gear when any piece falls to or below this condition (at basecamp).
